headline: Team Turducken moves to third on ARC-3

sections.text: Team Turducken gained 3.90 points to reach 52.82, moving from fifth to third on the ARC-3 public board.
The team now sits behind only Tufa Labs and Yi-Chia Chen in the standings.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
